requirement_summary: API, Web, VS Code, Report는 동일 상태 온톨로지와 Assurance Ceiling을 사용한다. `SELF_VALIDATION_NONFINAL PASS`를 단순 Final PASS로 축약하는 UI/문서 변환을 금지한다.
subject: ValidationReportExporter.markdown/html (the 'Report' surface -- the API surface already always returns raw self_validation_nonfinal/final_claim_allowed fields verbatim and was not modified; no Web or VS Code client exists anywhere in this repository to audit)
observed_source: src/main/java/kr/co/oruda/onsure/platform/ValidationCompletionGate.java (class Javadoc: "Fail-closed completeness policy for one nonfinal product validation run")
coverage_notes: This closure differs in shape from every other orphan_severity_recalculation closure this session: FR-META-043 is a DISPLAY/documentation-consistency requirement, not a decision-computation gate, so there is no new JSON contract schema/fixture pair here (there is no cross-field or cross-document comparison to validate -- the defect was purely that a real, already-correct non-final decision was rendered to a human reader with the qualifying context silently dropped). ValidationReportExporter had zero prior test coverage (grep for the class name across src/test/java/ returned nothing) and, before this change, rendered '- Decision: **PASS**' with no indication anywhere in the commercial user-facing Markdown/HTML report that the Decision came from ONSure's own self-validation and carries final_claim_allowed=false. ValidationCompletionGate's own pre-existing class Javadoc ('for one nonfinal product validation run') confirms non-finality is a structural, always-true property of every report this exporter renders, not a per-run variable -- so the fix adds one unconditional qualifier line, bound immediately after the Decision line (verified by index-adjacency in markdownNeverRendersDecisionWithoutTheSelfValidationNonfinalQualifier, not merely substring presence), using the identical self_validation_nonfinal/final_claim_allowed field-name tokens the V2 semantic-assurance API surface already attaches to every one of its own results -- satisfying '동일 상태 온톨로지' (same status ontology) literally rather than via a paraphrased disclaimer. html() delegates to markdown() through escape(), so both surfaces are fixed by the single change; qualifierIsUnconditionalAcrossEveryDecisionValue proves this holds for all 6 Decision enum values, not just PASS.
open_gap: kr.co.oruda.onsure.assurance.Decision.isFinalPassEligible() exists in the codebase (Decision.java) with zero callers anywhere (grep confirmed) -- it returns true purely from `this == PASS` with no access to self_validation_nonfinal/final_claim_allowed context, making its name misleading if a future caller adopts it naively. Not removed or renamed in this closure since it is inert dead code with no live behavior to fix and altering unrelated dead code was judged out of scope for this requirement; flagged here so a future pass does not wire a real caller to it without first fixing what 'eligible' means. Separately, docs/master/semantic-assurance/38_FORMAL_ASSURANCE_ALGEBRA_AND_STATE_LATTICE.md defines a full 6-axis (D,S,C,U,I,Q) Assurance Tuple that would generalize this same qualifier concern well beyond self_validation_nonfinal, but that document's own status is DESIGN_ONLY/DRAFT/NON_FINAL and is not implemented anywhere in this codebase yet -- this closure targets only the already-real, already-implemented self_validation_nonfinal/final_claim_allowed ontology in current use, not the draft algebra.
design_reference_gap: No lower-level design document specifies the exact rendered wording of a Report-surface non-final qualifier (unlike e.g. FR-META-041's field-pair mapping, which was at least inferable from existing schema field names); the wording used here was authored to satisfy the requirement's literal text (same field-name tokens as the API ontology, forbids the bare-Final-PASS reading) rather than derived from a pre-existing display-copy specification.
